how_to_read: Fetch each file listed below; each is small enough to read in full. Clusters are stories covered by several outlets, ranked best first (rank is the overall rank). Each cluster's key_facts are specific details (figures, quotes, dates) pulled from the member articles' own text, worth using over re-deriving the same facts from the summary. Singles are stories from one outlet. A story can appear in more than one file.

files.description: Highest-ranked stories overall, for 'what matters now'.
Economic currents: markets, central banks, energy, trade, currencies, companies.
Power & politics worldwide, excluding stories mainly about the US, UK or Egypt.
US monitor: stories mainly about the United States.
